name: Dominica
headline: Dominica: +4.5% growth in 2025, 0.9% inflation, debt 100% of GDP
sections: Dominica is a $744 million economy (2025), the world's 207th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +4.5% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $23K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 4.8% of GDP (2025).
Consumer prices rose 0.9% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 7.7% in 2022.
Gross government debt is 100% of GDP (2025), a elevated level that has fallen from 118% in 2020. The general government balance is −0.5% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is −38.7% of GDP (2025), a sizeable external financing need. Net FDI inflows were 6.8% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 83% of GDP by 2031, on a declining path from today's level. Life expectancy is 71.3 years (2024). Population: 75 thousand (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
